findings.evidence: `grep -n 'spatialNorm_n\|spatialNorm_spatialPart' code/EpsilonEridani` matches nothing outside `spatialNorm_nonneg`; the PR description nevertheless advertises "the simp lemmas `spatialNorm_n` and `spatialNorm_spatialPart`". With `spatialNorm` unexposed and `spatialNorm_def` unannotated, `simp` cannot touch `F.spatialNorm F.n`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] spatialNorm_n`, `@[simp] spatialNorm_spatialPart` (both one-liners from `spatialPart_n`/`spatialPart_spatialPart`), `@[simp] spatialNorm_zero`, and the matching `cosAngle_spatialPart_left/right`.
findings.issue: `spatialNorm` and `cosAngle` are opaque (no `@[expose]`, `spatialNorm_def`/`cosAngle_def` not `@[simp]`), yet they have no lemma for their interaction with the frame's own operations: `spatialNorm F.n = 0`, `spatialNorm (spatialPart p) = spatialNorm p`, `spatialNorm 0 = 0`, `cosAngle (spatialPart a) b = cosAngle a b`. A consumer must `rw [spatialNorm_def]` and redo the projection algebra by hand, although the parallel `spatialPart_n` (line 153) and `spatialPart_spatialPart` (line 161) are `@[simp]`.

findings.evidence: Kinematics/Basic.lean:74,79,90 have no attribute, while Jets/Frame/Basic.lean:143,152,160 mark the specializations `@[simp]`; the same file already marks `rankOne_apply` (144), `reflect_apply` (171) and `det_reflect` (195).
findings.fix: Mark the three with `@[simp]`; the `g u u ≠ 0` hypothesis is dischargeable as a simp side condition, as for `div_self`.
findings.issue: The normal-form lemmas of the new general projection carry no automation annotation: `projOrthogonal_orthogonal` (74), `projOrthogonal_apply_self` (79), `projOrthogonal_projOrthogonal` (90). Their `Frame` specializations `spatialPart_orthogonal_n`, `spatialPart_n`, `spatialPart_spatialPart` are all `@[simp]`, so direct users of `projOrthogonal` (`pTransverse`, and §1.2's Breit projection along `q`) get none of that automation.

findings.evidence: Four sites now chain the two lemmas: Tensors/Basic.lean:405, 411, 418, 508 (`simp only [pTransverse_def, Bilin.projOrthogonal_apply, …]`), plus ParityOdd.lean:444.
findings.fix: Add `lemma pTransverse_apply (g) (K) : pTransverse g K = K.p - (g K.p K.q / g K.q K.q) • K.q := g.projOrthogonal_apply _ _` and use it at the call sites.
findings.issue: Redefining `pTransverse` as `g.projOrthogonal K.q K.p` leaves no single lemma for its characterizing formula `K.p - (g K.p K.q / g K.q K.q) • K.q`; every consumer must chain `pTransverse_def` with `Bilin.projOrthogonal_apply`.

summary: The Frame surface is minimal and bodies are correctly unexposed, but the opaque `spatialNorm`/`cosAngle` lack the interaction lemmas their `spatialPart` counterparts have (two of which the PR description claims exist), the general `projOrthogonal` normal-form lemmas carry no `@[simp]` while their `Frame` specializations do, and `pTransverse` no longer has a single lemma for its explicit formula.
